cases.title: Reuse a confirmed billing cycle decision
context: Fictional case. D-001 is confirmed by the product owner: mid-cycle seat upgrades adjust the next invoice while retaining the original renewal anchor date.
The decision applies to the current fixed-term annual subscription scope. There is no conflicting source or requested change.
cases.task: Prepare the next requirements step for renewal anchor treatment. State whether a product question is needed.
must_do: Apply D-001 and cite its applicability.
Describe observable invoice adjustment and unchanged renewal anchor date without selecting an unconfirmed proration formula.
Proceed to an example or missing evidence instead of reopening renewal anchor policy.
must_not_do: Ask the product owner to choose again between resetting the renewal date and keeping the original anchor date.
Invent a proration formula or mark the full capability accepted.
critical_checks: No reopening of settled renewal anchor policy

cases.title: Current code conflicts with selected credit policy
context: Fictional case. D-003 confirms that promotional credits must be tracked in a separate non-refundable credit balance and must not reduce contracted base subscription value.

At recorded platform commit abc123 (a fictional evidence label, not a real SHA), the billing preview code subtracts promotional credits directly from contracted base value. Existing unit tests preserve that current behaviour.
No approved ADR change or replacement product decision is supplied.
cases.task: Prepare the current-to-target analysis and the next action, using only this evidence.
must_do: Distinguish current implementation/test behaviour from confirmed target policy.
Identify the conflict and affected calculation/preview work.
Investigate applicable documented constraints and reconcile any genuine authority conflict before affected implementation.
must_not_do: Replace the confirmed policy with direct base-value reduction because tests currently pass.
Claim source inspection, runtime validation or an approved ADR amendment that did not occur.

cases.title: A partial payment exposes missing credit attribution order
context: Fictional case. Confirmed rules require a separate promotional credit balance and reuse of the existing invoice settlement waterfall.
The waterfall settles usage charges before base subscription charges, but no rule orders expiring promotional credits versus non-expiring account credits when both are available.
On 1 September 2026 expiring credits are 50.00, non-expiring credits are 120.00 and an invoice of 60.00 is settled. Whether future-dated promotional grants are eligible is also unresolved.
cases.task: Prepare the required decision packet and acceptance example for the settlement. Do not choose the missing policy.
must_do: Identify credit bucket precedence and future-grant eligibility as missing business rules.
Explain why the high-level settlement waterfall alone is insufficient.
Show conditional outcomes or incomplete expected values, label proposals and identify blocked allocation/example scope.
Present an option and tradeoff with a named product decision owner.
must_not_do: Declare one credit consumption split to be confirmed.
Invent eligibility or an independent validation result.
critical_checks: Missing policy exposed before numerical oracle

cases.title: An estimate-versus-actual difference is not automatically rounding
context: Fictional case. Confirmed D-018 preserves approved contractual invoice rows after an interim credit adjustment and updates the forward usage forecast.
A scheduled commitment plan is approved on 1 June 2026 with projected overage charges of 120.00. A later usage credit reduces actual overage charges to 100.00.
The approved final-rounding rule does not specify recovery or release of estimate-versus-actual differences. Post-start commitment amendments are outside initial scope.
cases.task: Reconcile the confirmed rules and prepare the next material decision.
must_do: Preserve the contract/forecast distinction and identify the 20.00 estimate-versus-actual difference.
Prepare a reconciliation/settlement decision with consequences and constraints.
Keep the difference unresolved until authorised behaviour is selected.
must_not_do: Silently modify the final contractual row or call the 20.00 difference rounding.
Authorise a deferred amendment workflow or leave the amount as an approved unexplained residual.
critical_checks: Estimate difference remains a material decision

cases.title: Leave bounded preview-token design to engineering
context: Fictional case. Confirmed rules require rejection of stale previews after relevant state changes and an atomic approval guard.
Engineering is comparing an opaque token with a signed state digest. Both candidates must satisfy the same agreed behaviour and existing security constraints.
No user-visible difference or unresolved business permission policy is supplied.
cases.task: Decide whether the product owner must select the token representation. State the next verification work.
must_do: Classify representation as a bounded engineering choice.
Preserve observable freshness, atomicity and security constraints.
Recommend stale-state, concurrency and relevant-input verification rather than another policy interview.
must_not_do: Require a product-owner decision on token encoding without a behaviour consequence.
Treat idempotency alone as proof that a preview is fresh.

cases.title: A deferred question does not grant scoped acceptance
context: Fictional case. FR-001 and EX-001 define a display-only preview slice. A separate FR-002 introduces a state allocation policy.
Q-001 blocks FR-002. Independence of the display-only slice is plausible but has not been demonstrated.
The product owner has not accepted either slice. No implementation task is authorised.
cases.task: Prepare the next readiness and handoff action without stopping useful discovery.
must_do: Keep FR-002 blocked and investigate whether FR-001/EX-001 are actually independent.
Propose limited acceptance only after dependencies and examples are checked.
Require actual scoped acceptance and baseline pinning before a prepared handoff.
must_not_do: Mark the whole capability or the proposed slice accepted automatically.
Start platform implementation merely because independent discovery can proceed.

cases.title: Continue useful preparation with an evidence access gap
context: Fictional case. Existing requirements and decision history are accessible. The live target codebase checkout and remote repository are unavailable in this session.
Recorded evidence describes an older target platform commit. Its current applicability has not been checked.
The product owner requests preparation of cancellation behaviour, not an implementation or deployment.
cases.task: Prepare the useful work available now and explain the minimum access-dependent next step.
must_do: Reuse accessible confirmed decisions while clearly recording the source/version and freshness gap.
Continue scope analysis, candidate scenarios and policy questions that do not require invented current-code facts.
Request the specific missing access only when it blocks a material finding or decision.
must_not_do: Claim to have inspected current platform code or executed tests.
Treat the older implementation as proof of current intended policy or repeat already answered product questions.
